messages:
Maya (CSM): Day0 kickoff for MeridianBridge private VPC onboarding. Quick sync on peering, FW, IAM, KMS BYOK, and audit-log export. Meeting in 25m: https://zoom.redwood/mb-day0. Reply with blockers. :wave:
Miguel (MeridianBridge): Thanks! We raised VPC peering request (ticket MB-124). Waiting for route tables to be accepted on your side.
Adele (NetOps): I can see the peering request. Accepting now. Miguel — can you confirm Meridian CIDR ranges? I'll check for overlaps.
Miguel (MeridianBridge): CIDRs: 10.240.0.0/16 (apps), 10.241.0.0/16 (mgmt). Redwood side was provisioned as 10.50.0.0/16.
Adele (NetOps): no overlaps, accepting and pushing route table entries. ETA ~5m. :white_check_mark:
Josh (Eng Oncall): Heads up — control-plane whitelist needed: outbound 443 to 34.87.12.9/32 and 9411 for tracing. Also we prefer health check port 5233/TCP. @Sam (Security) confirm.
Sam (Security): Confirmed. Add 34.87.12.9/32:443, 34.87.12.9/9411 and 34.87.12.9/5233. Also KMS access required to kms.redwood.internal on 443. Send us the customer egress policy after it's applied.
Miguel (MeridianBridge): We can add those. Quick Q: BYOK — you want us to create a key in our KMS and share ARN? Or do you create a CMK in our account?
Maya (CSM): MeridianBridge prefers BYOK. We usually request a customer-managed CMK with cross-account key policy allowing Redwood service principal. @Sam — I'll attach the policy template.
Sam (Security): Pasting minimal policy template below. Replace <MERIDIAN_ACCOUNT> and <KEY_ARN>:
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "AllowRedwoodUse",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::REDFWD:role/redwood-service"},
      "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
      "Resource": "<KEY_ARN>"
    }
  ]
}
```
Miguel (MeridianBridge): Policy applied, shared key ARN arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef12. Tagged "redwood:meridianbridge". :thumbsup:
Adele (NetOps): Route tables updated, peering Active, security groups whitelist in place for 34.87.12.9. Verified via traceroute to control-plane.
deploy-bot: Deployment note: private-proxy v1.2.0 scheduled to register with MB VPC at 2026-03-22T15:45:00Z. No action needed unless revert requested.
Josh (Eng Oncall): I'll run a quick end-to-end smoke test once the proxy registers. Ping me when deploy-bot status is "registered".
Miguel (MeridianBridge): Smoke tests look good from our side (DB connections, egress). Saw slight RTO on one call — sending logs to your S3 link in the meeting convo.
Maya (CSM): Great progress. Action items: Sam send full KMS policy doc (done), Adele confirm egress ACLs (done), Josh run smoke test and report by EOD, Miguel share any post-cutover issues in this channel. We'll reconvene after smoke test. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
